g.text: Takeaway: strained, n-doped Ge is predicted to give ~300 cm⁻¹ of gain and positive gain from ~1000 A/cm² (10× less at 1.8% strain) —

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: enough for a 10–100 cm⁻¹ cavity if Γ is large; but for Ge, low-loss cavities are not a viable path to lower threshold current [45].
